header_text: Red Line: Delays of about 15 minutes due to a medical emergency at Broadway.
Ruggles Escalator 136 (Orange Line platform to upper lobby) is unavailable due to maintenance.
Downtown Crossing Escalator 113 (Alewife platform to Hawley Street) is unavailable due to maintenance.
South Station Escalator 388 (Lobby to CSA area) is unavailable due to maintenance.
Ashmont Escalator 438 (Ashmont platform to Mattapan Line, busway) is unavailable due to maintenance.
Orange Line: Delays of about 15 minutes due to a disabled train at Malden Center. Trains may stand by at stations.

Due to construction, the staircase at the north end of the Savin Hill platform is out of service. Riders should follow station personnel and signage to the alternate staircase located in the center of the platform.

Red Line: To allow for switch and rail upgrades, shuttle buses will replace service between Broadway and North Quincy from Nov 20 - 22. Trains will operate between JFK/UMass & Ashmont. Commuter Rail will be fare-free between Braintree and South Station.
Orange Line: Delays of about 25 minutes due to a disabled train at Malden Center. Trains may stand by at stations.

The platform at Jackson Square is undergoing renovations to improve safety and accessibility. Sections of the platform are unlevel, which may make it difficult for some riders to board and exit trains.
The west bike cage at Alewife will be closed due to maintenance beginning Monday, December 14. Bikers may use the east bike cage.

Green Line C Branch: The outbound Hawes St platform is now fully accessible, but there is no accessible connection to the Beacon St eastbound sidewalk. This path is expected to be available after December 12.

Quincy Adams Garage Notice: Beginning Tuesday, November 3, MBTA parking at Quincy Adams will be limited to the A side of the Garage. The B side of the garage will be reserved for Logan Express Braintree.
Orange Line: Delays of about 20 minutes due to a disabled train at Malden Center. Trains may stand by at stations.

Red Line: To allow for switch and rail upgrades, shuttle buses are replacing service between Broadway and North Quincy through Nov 22. Trains are operating between JFK/UMass & Ashmont. Commuter Rail is fare-free between Braintree and South Station.

Green Line C Branch: Inbound trains are not stopping at Hawes St through December 10, while accessibility upgrades are being done. The closest stops with service are Saint Mary’s St and Kent St, which are 0.2-0.3 miles away (about a 4 - 6 minute walk).
Assembly Escalator 443 (Platform to Foley Street paid lobby) is unavailable due to maintenance.
State Escalator 6 (Oak Grove platform to Old State House lobby) is unavailable.

The stairway connecting the Jackson Square lobby and the south end of the platform is closed until winter 2026. Use the stairway at the north end of the platform. This closure is for the construction of a new stairway and a second elevator.
Maverick Escalator 428 (Unpaid lobby to Lewis Mall) is unavailable.
Andrew Escalator 124 (Ashmont/Braintree platform to busway) is unavailable.
